name: Stripe
description: Stripe payments become events: Placed Order for paid Checkout sessions and subscription invoices, Refunded Order for refunds, and Subscription Started and Subscription Cancelled. Customers who tick Checkout's promotional-emails box are subscribed to email; nobody else is.

signature_secret.label: Stripe webhook signing secret
signature_secret.help: Starts with whsec_. In the Stripe Dashboard: Developers → Webhooks → your endpoint → Signing secret.

setup: Create the integration from this recipe. Copy its inbound URL.

In the Stripe Dashboard, go to Developers → Webhooks → Add endpoint. Paste the inbound URL and choose these events: checkout.session.completed, invoice.paid, charge.refunded, customer.subscription.created, customer.subscription.deleted.
Copy the endpoint's signing secret (whsec_…) and save it as the integration's signing secret.
Send a test event from Stripe (or use test_integration with a sample event) and check the delivery log.
To subscribe buyers to email, turn on Checkout's promotional emails consent (consent_collection.promotions = auto). Only people who tick the box are subscribed.

flows.name: Stripe: subscription win-back
flows.description: A day after a subscription is cancelled, asks what went wrong and invites them back.

content.subject: Sorry to see you go, {{ first_name|default('friend') }}
content.preheader: Tell us what we could do better

blocks.html:
Thanks for being a subscriber. If something wasn't right, reply and tell us; we read every answer.

You're welcome back any time.
